verdict.rationale: Better Auth is code-first by design, with no dashboard step required ([45]). Its documented operations are exposed programmatically through server-side auth.api methods ([23]) and client methods ([4], [67]). That coverage includes admin actions such as creating users, managing roles, banning and impersonating ([15]), plus 2FA management ([48], [53]), API key management ([42]), and organization management ([13]). However, one user reported that running admin scripts and tests outside the request-header flow was very hacky ([comm-6]), no OpenAPI spec was found at the probed paths ([probe-3]), and the client library is JS-only ([comm-20]). Missing for 10: a published OpenAPI spec for the HTTP endpoints, smooth headless/scripted admin usage outside request context, and documented non-JS client support.
